evidence.title: JX Advanced Metals IPO on Tokyo Stock Exchange
evidence.summary: JX Advanced Metals Corporation IPO on Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) with listing code 5016 on March 19, 2025. IPO priced at 820 yen per share.

evidence.title: Nordson Corporation SEC 10-Q Filing
evidence.summary: Nordson Corporation SEC Form 10-Q filing confirms ticker NDSN on NASDAQ (not NSA).

evidence.title: SUSS MicroTec SE Frankfurt Stock Exchange Listing
evidence.summary: SUSS MicroTec SE confirmed trading on Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Xetra) under ticker SMHN (not SUU). As of June 4, 2026, company promoted to MDAX index.

evidence.title: IQE plc London Stock Exchange AIM Listing
evidence.summary: IQE plc confirmed trading on London Stock Exchange (AIM segment) under ticker IQE.L (not bare 'IQE').

evidence.title: LandMark Optoelectronics Taipei Exchange Listing
evidence.summary: LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation confirmed trading on Taipei Exchange (TPEx) under ticker 3081.TWO (not TWSE). Public listing metric was previously missing.

evidence.title: Wolfspeed Inc. Chapter 11 Emergence and Restructuring
evidence.summary: Wolfspeed Inc. emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy on September 29, 2025. Ticker WOLF (NYSE) remains valid. Company completed debt reduction of ~70% and equity issuances to Renesas.
